thread:
Priya S: FYI — flagged a midmarket account (Northbridge Inc) with clear churn risk. usage down 65% week-over-week, onboarding incomplete, and finance mentioned downgrade intent in renewal call. Need a quick save plan we can run this afternoon.
Mateo R: can we get the activation metrics + last 2 weeks of support tickets first?
Priya S: pulled basic dashboard: activation 30% complete, avg latency complaints on embeddings route, 3 support tickets (2 untriaged). sent csv to the thread via DM.
Samir K: we should offer a 1:1 enablement session and a quick credits/top-up for a month to buy time. propose: 1) schedule enablement, 2) propose temporary discount + free tuning session, 3) escalate embedding perf to eng.
Jordan L: on the perf side: looks like they're on a dense model config without prefix caching. we can propose a low-risk config change: enable KV prefix cache + reduce max_tokens for background jobs. ops change, should be reversible.
Mei W: sounds good. also capture feedback — they're confused about our billing buckets; that's driving downgrade. recommend a line-item breakdown + short doc. I'll draft.
Priya S: OK owners: Samir = customer convo (offer + enablement), Jordan = perf triage + run config change, Mei = billing note + 1-pager. I'll coordinate exec summary to CS leader. ETA EOD.
Mateo R: quick operational checklist I recommend we run now:
```
- Confirm account loyalty signals (ARR, contract end date)
- Run activation rescue: invite to onboarding session + include checklist + 1:1 link
- Apply temporary credit for 30 days (ops)
- Triage embedding perf: create ticket with sample payloads and latency traces
- Draft billing breakdown email and attach 1-pager
- Offer escalation path: named solutions engineer for 2 weeks
```
Samir K: I'll ping customer now. short note: "we saw workflow slowdown and onboarding gap — want to jump on a 30-min call today? we can offer a month credit while we fix perf." :phone:
Jordan L: creating internal perf ticket: INF-6012, adding traces and config snapshot. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. expecting a patch that toggles prefix caching and slight batch size change. ETA 6 hours.
Mei W: billing 1-pager draft attached (I'll DM). includes sample invoice with token breakdown and a TL;DR about predictability options (Dedicated vs hosted limits).
cs-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 48h (thread reminder).
Priya S: great — capture customer replies and any objections in the thread. if they push for permanent discount, we escalate to AM for a negotiated path. otherwise run the quick save steps and we reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
Mateo R: noted. logging play outcome in retention tracker once done.
Samir K: customer accepted 30-min slot at 3pm. sharing calendar invite.
Jordan L: applied safe config toggle to their staging pool. monitoring. initial p95 token latency improved ~28%.
Mei W: sent billing 1-pager and proactive FAQ. customer responded: "appreciate the clarity — send the tuning notes after the call".
Priya S: win for now. follow-up plan: 1) complete enablement, 2) monitor metrics + confirm activation to >60%, 3) finalize renewal cadence and decision by next week. logging this thread into the playbook repo after close.
Samir K: assigning postmortem/notes to retention ticket RET-4821.
Priya S: thanks team. if anyone sees new friction, post here.
